acquisition_method.evidence: The data were acquired in data-independent acquisition (DIA) mode, whereby each scan cycle consisted of 1 MS1 scan (scan range 350–1250 m/z, resolution 60 K, AGC 3e6, max. IT = 30 ms) and 40 variable window MS2 scans (resolution 15 K, AGC 1e6, max. IT = 50 ms).

instrument.evidence: Soft tissues were totally removed and skeletal samples were pulverized into powder in liquid nitrogen for protein extraction before sending for nanoLC-MS/MS (Q Exactive HF-X and EASY-nLC 1200) mass spectrometry at Sangon Biotech.

ionization_type.evidence: Soft tissues were totally removed and skeletal samples were pulverized into powder in liquid nitrogen for protein extraction before sending for nanoLC-MS/MS (Q Exactive HF-X and EASY-nLC 1200) mass spectrometry at Sangon Biotech.

labeling.evidence: inferred: The DIA raw data files were processed with the DIA-NN software (v 1.8), using the human proteome reference database on UniProt (dated March 12, 2021, total 20 381 protein sequences).
